llm.summary: This looks like a test skill, but its body contains unrelated instructions about broad codebase changes that do not match the stated no-op purpose.

dimensions.detail: No direct filesystem, network, credential, or command use is bundled, but the instructions describe changes to sensitive application areas that are disproportionate for a no-op test skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains only a Markdown SKILL.md artifact, with no executable installer, dependency file, bundled script, or remote payload mechanism observed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime text is not scoped to a user-invoked test task and could steer an agent toward unrelated repository, authentication, and API changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism is installed by the artifact itself; however, the described database and ownership-model changes would be persistent if an agent acted on the instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The description says the skill has no practical meaning and is for testing, but the body discusses database redesign, Microsoft OAuth, file fetching changes, and a delete endpoint.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Only install this if you intentionally want a disposable test skill. Its contents appear to be stray planning notes rather than a coherent skill, and an agent could treat them as instructions to modify authentication, database ownership, file visibility, or deletion behavior in an unrelated codebase.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] unexpected: The Chinese-only description is a localization and clarity issue, but it is not the basis for the Review verdict; the material concern is the mismatch between the no-op test description and the broad codebase-change instructions in the skill body.
